# MeshCore for Wadamesh RX power saving

This directory contains the library sources from
[meshcomod core-v1.18.0](https://github.com/ALLFATHER-BV/meshcomod/tree/6a8906212e9071efa4d3699a623b1a5ec8e2de6e).
The RX power saving calculations, profiles, CLI, and SX1262 and LR1110 duty cycle support
come from [IoTThinks/MeshCore PowerSaving-v18](https://github.com/IoTThinks/MeshCore/tree/7542eb5b933617590ee5fa08220e958edc91b7a9).
The radio wrapper integrates the duty cycle with meshcomod's receive queue.
See `license.txt` for the license.
